summary: George Russell controlled the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole position, repelling Max Verstappen's assault in the final laps as two safety car periods compressed the field in a frantic conclusion. Russell reflected on the weekend as "the most dominant I've had in my career," marking a return to form after a difficult stretch that had tested his confidence. The victory narrows championship leader Kimi Antonelli's advantage as Mercedes positions itself as a genuine threat in the title fight.
